#1岁宝宝吃柿子牛肉呕吐不止#
刚发现华为手机的功能非常强大，我刚刚说了一段话，手机立刻帮我翻译成了英文：
I have encountered several cases of stomach stones caused by eating persimmons（n. 柿子） in the past, most of which involved school-age children. Persimmons contain tannic acid, and eating them on an empty stomach can easily lead to the formation of stomach stones.
我的意思是说：我以前遇到过几个吃柿子引起胃结石的病例，大多数是学龄儿童。柿子含有很多的鞣酸，容易引起胃结石。
我说的第2句话，它也把我翻译成了英语：
To avoid stomach stones caused by eating persimmons, there are several precautions to take: do not eat persimmons on an empty stomach, do not eat too many persimmons at once, and do not eat unripe persimmons. When eating persimmons, always peel them and eat the peeled fruit, and do not swallow the seeds whole. Additionally, avoid eating persimmons with high-protein foods, including crab and eggs.
我的意思是说：为避免吃柿子引起胃结石，有几点需要注意：不要在空腹时吃柿子；一次不能吃太多的柿子；一定要剥了皮吃，不能连核一起吞。另外还要注意吃柿子不要与高蛋白的食物一起吃，包括螃蟹、鸡蛋等。
大家看一看，上面这二段话翻译的对不对？
